convex-sets-paper-expandable.summary: Paper_Readings.convex_sets_are_expandable still concludes only the formal `expandable K`. Prove the paper's Section 4 claim directly: compact K, convex K and interior K nonempty imply paper_expandable K. Take R_i = mat 1 and b_i = (1-i) x0 with x0 in interior K, via HOL mem_interior_convex_shrink (about 30 lines). `expandable K` then follows from paper_expandable_imp_expandable. convex_expandable stays as a KEEP_EVIDENCE root.
